limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Authoritative contracts/loans (Pentagon, DoW), Rheinmetall guidance cut, multilateral defense pacts, Canada NATO budget, and munitions demand are material; podcasts/opeds excluded.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Verified GDP/unemployment/industrial data across US, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Germany, France, Philippines and Sierra Leone fiscal risk; local/promotional items excluded.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Authoritative EIA data, MARAD port approval, refinery/tanker supply shocks, IEA India demand, LNG agreements and sanctions are distinct verified supply events; stock-picking/promotional pieces excluded.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Bank liquidity/profit stress, gold-loan defaults, credit-card delinquency, CDS spreads and central-bank credibility are material; promotional/local items excluded.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: FDA approvals, Medicare pay rules, Medicaid work requirements/litigation, Advantage disruption and CMS pass-through are verified policy events affecting health equities.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Verified state changes (EU Ukraine disbursement, sanctions, Greenland basing, DPRK war prep), material oil-supply shocks from refinery attacks, and World Bank regional forecast; speculation/promotional items excluded.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: BoE hike, euro-area CPI/PPI, Fed speakers, Norges Bank, Canada framework renewal and Brazil rate-cut fade are verified macro policy events.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Midterm outcome and war-linked market moves, oil crash, Paraguay bank collapse, Israel coalition, and natural-hazard emergencies are distinct high-transmission events.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Verified gold/silver price moves, World Bank forecast, central-bank buying and producer financing are material; gold-plated Oval Office and stock-picking noise excluded.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Chip selloff, AI-buildout policy pushback, data-center ballot/legislative actions and major capex announcements are distinct verified developments; stock picks excluded.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Concrete policy actions (China-US farm/tariff linkage, NPA anti-subsidy extension, canola/steel relief, Norwegian salmon removal, EU steel tariffs, Canada budget) over election commentary.
